newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metal Man. in Thailand optical venture.
newsitem.headline: Metal Man. in Thailand optical venture.

text.p: Metal Manufacturers (MM) said it has forged a joint venture agreement between associate Biccor and United Communications Group (UCOM) for the manufacture and marketing of optical fibre communication cables in Thailand.
The new business, BICC UCOM Cables Co Ltd, will be owned 65 percent by Biccor and 35 percent by UCOM, and total investment for the project will amount to some US$20 million.
The project has already received approval from the Thai Board of Investments, Metal Maufacturers said in a statement.
"MM has been a key supplier of cable to UCOM for several years and has establised a strong working relationship" said MM Managing director, Glenn Dudley.

"During this period we have been closely following the Thai cable market, and believe that by combining with UCOM, Biccor will be working with a strong and well estbalished participant in the Thai telecommunications sector," Dudley added.
There are currently no optical cable maufacturing facilities in Thailand with imports satisfying 100 percent of local requirements.
The joint venture will be establishing a new cable maufacturing facility in the Eastern Seaboard region of Thailand, 150 km from Bangkok, and will benefit from a package of investment incentives.
The new facility will become operational in 1998.
